title: Original-DOS visibility fixture
description: One phase change run through the executed routine (demo): the tail of the order handler 02dc:1a09-1cc6 after the attacking side's orders, with the container sync 02dc:23e5, the destroyed marks 02dc:2b1d and the map copy 0e40:1d9d. The demo has no sight range: this is the only place one side's view of the other is brought up to date. Numbers only. Live records 0-0xf0 not listed carry flag 0x8000 (no unit); container records not listed have free slots (0xff) and zeros otherwise. The per-side records (0x31 bytes from 32e2:4d88) hold filler byte 0x40 + 0x31*side + offset before the change, except the phase byte +0x16; both attack order counts hold 0x55 and the animation flags 0x0101.

map.description: Two bytes per cell in rows of width cells: the terrain record, then the occupant (a live unit index, 0xf4 a building with units, 0xff none).

units.description: The live units set up (26-byte records at 32e2:1892).

flags4.description: Live +4: side bits 1 and 2 (2 neutral), 0x40/0x80 a two-cell ship's rear/head, 0x4000 in a container, 0x8000 destroyed.

size.description: Live +2; 0 marks the unit destroyed at the change.

pos.description: Live +0x0b and +0x0d: the unit's map offset 2*cell+1 as side 0 and side 1 see it.

facing.description: Live +0x0f and +0x10: its direction as each side sees it.

records.description: The container records set up, as in container-fixture.schema.json.

attacker.description: The side whose attack orders ran (DI; the handler takes side 0 when its phase byte is 2).

phase.description: The phase bytes (+0x16 of the per-side records) of side 0 and side 1 before the change.

count.description: The turn counter (32e2:4cab) before the change.

live.description: The 26 bytes of every listed unit afterwards.

holds.description: The 0x1c bytes of every container record that changed.

players.description: The 0x31 bytes of side 0's and side 1's per-side record afterwards.

orders.description: The count bytes of side 0's and side 1's attack order lists (32e2:4d3e, 4d55).

messages.description: [code, side] of every status message shown (0x35, 0x36).
